slides.title: External Services
slides.html:
• External Services link you to other sites avaivable in your Deploy App instance.
  • These are not necessary needed in day to day operations, but grant more features for power users.
  • Currently these are most useful for TAK & TAK Plugin users.

slides.title: Accessing External Services
slides.html:
• External Services can be accessed from the sidebar.
  • Select "Admin Tools" and then "External Services".

slides.title: Services Available
slides.html:
• The available services vary from deployment to deployment depending on what services you have ordered.
  • Each should have a short description of what it does.
  • They open by clicking on them and should ask for your mTLS-certificate for secure login.

slides.title: Keycloak
slides.html:
• Presently, via Keycloak you can manage groups users have.
  • This has effect to TAK users as this group setup is synced to the TAK Server.
  • In expected use, you don't have to touch Keycloak at all.
  • Experienced users can do a lot, eg. connect external applications to your Deploy App.
